«ما رُوِيَ عَنِ» is passive: no transmitter is written before the Imam; the Imam named after «عن» is the single link (rule 10); his honorific is left out
The Qur'anic verses inside the saying are not chain material
«مَا رُوِيَ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» has the Imam as the only link, named after «عن» (ruling 2: narrator); the blessing is left out.
The Qur'an quotation in the saying is not a chain.
